title: Automatic dampers.
officialText:
Automatic dampers shall be listed and labeled in accordance with UL 17 for oil-fired heating
appliances. The dampers shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions. An automatic vent
damper device shall not be installed on an existing appliance unless the appliance is listed and labeled and the device is installed in
accordance with the terms of its listing. The name of the installer and date of installation shall be marked on a label affixed to the
damper device.
